claims.claim_text: Directed control-plane architecture for a governed multi-agent platform, establishing a policy-gated agent execution surface for regulated enterprise AI workflows.
Aligned enterprise generative-AI adoption to CFO priorities, generating CFO-aligned adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization.
Built evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls into production agent runtimes, delivering audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through monitoring, compressing the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks for client deployments.
Architected distributed cloud and Databricks Lakehouse data infrastructure for agentic workloads, achieving high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms.
Converted bespoke delivery into reusable platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 to support agentic platform commercialization.
